This page tells you which area of the site holds which kind of page, so a new
page goes where a reader looks for it. The site has five areas, one per navbar
item, each with one sidebar; a page belongs to the area of the folder it lives
in. The Chinese pages have the same paths under `zh-TW/docs/`.

## Areas of the site {#areas}

| Area | What it holds | Folder |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Get started | The home page (`README.md`, shown by `index.qmd`), installing, the first simulation and choosing a simulation | `docs/start/` |
| Guides | One task per page: preparing and checking a layout, computing a quantity with one solver, convergence and reports, running elsewhere, working with a finished run, the flip-chip Xmon worked example and upgrading | `docs/guides/` |
| Concepts | The physical problem and the model behind each calculation, in plain words | `docs/concepts/` |
| Reference | What is supported, terms and units, the API index and the detailed specifications | `docs/reference/` |
| Contribute | The entry page and its reading order, the code map, architecture, ownership by area, provenance, the notebook contract, the internals of each area (`internals/`), research and history; in Chinese only, the SGB design pages | `docs/contribute/` |

A page that moves keeps its old URL and its old section anchors, as
[DOCS_STYLE.md](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/blob/develop/DOCS_STYLE.md)
section 3 states; links between pages always use the current path. The PDK
notebook for each calculation is listed on
[Choose a simulation](../start/choose-a-simulation.qmd).
<span id="orcapen-to-scgsim-topics"></span>An OrcaPen page that needs an
SCGSim topic links the section of the [Reference overview](../reference/index.qmd)
that covers it.
